name: QuietJar
description: An embeddable donation button that lives directly on your own site, so supporters can give in a couple of taps without a redirect.
featureList: On-page checkout with no redirect to a separate donation page
Wallet payments (Apple Pay, Google Pay), cards, and iDEAL
Polite, server-side suppression of repeat prompts after a donation
Goal and progress bars for fundraising targets
